description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into a linked list of tokens, with internal validation checks.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and adds valid tokens to the linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes the validation check.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Validates that the token is not empty.
